title: SwiGLU Feed-Forward
signature: def swiglu_ffn(x: np.ndarray, W1: np.ndarray, W3: np.ndarray, W2: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray
hints: There are two up-projections: x @ W1 is the gate and x @ W3 is the value.
SiLU (Swish) is z * sigmoid(z). Apply it to the gate only.
Multiply gate and value elementwise, then project down with W2.
